decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a low-cost system component that supports the firm's established track lighting and was featured on the home page, so it likely meets aspirations and needs no problemistic search.
LED luminaires turn over quickly in premium lighting and evidence after 2018 is lacking, but in a growing industry the firm likely has enough slack to keep a product close to its core.
The home automation server box underpins the firm's control ecosystem and strategic direction, so it is likely kept despite uncertain results, and updated rather than withdrawn.
A luminaire family with its own page signals strategic importance, and in a growing market it likely performs near aspiration, so dropping it is unlikely within the year.
